name: Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd.
summary: Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel pipes, surface treated steel sheets, and poles in Japan, North America, and Asia. The company offers structural steel pipes; steel tube for piping; steel conduit and accessories; tubes and accessories for cable protection; synthetic resin-coated tubes for cable protection; lighting and signal pols, and equipment mounting column; and steel sheets. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
